summary:
Chartered Accountant with 5+ years of progressive experience in Statutory Audit, Financial Reporting, IFRS, Risk
Assessment, and Client Management, including Big 4 exposure at KPMG.

bullets: Performed statutory audit for various Australian clients including manufacturing, healthcare, retail sector, and service sector including non-profit clients ensuring 100% compliance with IFRS and regulatory framework.

Performed Test of Details during audit procedures on multiple areas including revenue, accounts receivable and payable, inventory, investments, treasury and debts, resulting in 25% reduction in audit-related risks.
Review of financial statements for any inconsistencies, inaccuracy and casting errors & preparing disclosures for the financial statements.

Managed portfolio of 3-4 concurrent clients with revenue ranging from $200M to $2.2B, prioritizing tasks and ensuring timely completion of deliverables, and maintaining strong onshore and client communication.

Led audit teams of 3-4 members, managing workflow allocation, utilization, supervision and review of work papers, resulting in increase in team efficiency through structured planning and targeted coaching.
Performed 100+Walkthrough procedures, minute’s summarization and prepared
Worked on substantive audit procedures during audit, Reconciliations etc. variances. Used various sampling tools as well as techniques such as MUS,
Ensured 100% compliance with audit documentation standards and internal
Supported senior auditors in conducting complex financial analysis and fieldwork, and operational processes.
Participated in 10+ on-site audits, collecting essential documentation and verifying statements.
Preparation and finalization of Financial Statements like Balance sheet, P&L A/c along
Application of Accounting Standards and checking the compliance thereof, Checking Revised schedule III.
